purpose: In-flight constructive research update with accepted W003 norm-gate relation; not a new review round
message:
In-flight update to your EXISTING W004 constructive research task, not a new delegated review or a new round. Preserve your original frozen inputs and scope; append this update to your evidence instead of replacing those inputs. The independent W003 norm-gate review has completed and the coordinator accepted its scoped findings in research/findings/W003-normgate-disposition.md. You may now read the completed research/findings/W003-normgate-review.md (SHA256 6418998b6e1e3f5e3708011ca7e8c4261f66b98be6aee1b57558f815fe521269) and the disposition; they are no longer live drafts. Lens B is also accepted with corrections in research/findings/W003-root-priorart-disposition.md. This lifecycle update overrides stale wording in your frozen W004 brief; the brief itself stays unchanged.

Material new accepted construction: for f(T)=T^2-(u^2+v^2)T+t^2, t=2R, rows (t,u),(v,1) give Q(T)=(t^2-u^2*T)*(v^2-T), Q(alpha)=alpha*(v^2-alpha)^2. Thus the rational-pair one-field twisted target is explicit, with O(n)-bit data and polynomial overhead AFTER paid Norm2. This corrects the parent note's overly pessimistic one-field statement. It is a different packet from P_j in the W004 frozen brief. Let g=v^2-R mod N: the row images are R*g and g; proper gcd(g,N) gives a factor, g=0 gives root v, unit g leaves only the twisted relation. No frequency follows. Norm(v^2-alpha)=t^2-u^2*v^2, and the other row norm is t^2 times that. Do not infer smoothness.

Accepted obstruction: conjugating the same f sends Q(alpha)=alpha*z^2 to Q(alpha')=alpha'*tau(z)^2, so the second value cannot be an ordinary nonzero square while alpha is nonsquare. This closes conjugate reuse only; independent fields remain open. Also [alpha]=[s+2t]=[s-2t] in K*/K*2, so no character can exclude alpha from ALL one-field rational-pair rows. Use this explicit packet as a constructive starting point for the common mixed target if useful; do not duplicate the now-settled one-field question. Price finding a second field in which the SAME Q is a square, actual roots, unit reduction, heights and failed attempts. A quartic/elliptic descent or square-class criterion is not a free selector or rational-point oracle. Your auxiliary-prime/CRT selector and all new conclusions still require independent review.

Source/cost boundary unchanged: deterministic Norm2 reference is O(N*n^2) time/O(N*n) bits on fixed multitapes. AEM full primary text was not obtained in six focused reviewer searches; do not restart that search. Treat any faster Norm2 as an explicit conditional parameter. No new complete factoring improvement. Continue your original constructive task within your exclusive W004-biquadratic-* ownership, symbolic/source work only, no mathematical execution, experiments, implementation or Lean; deliver the result under your existing task handle.
